protocol.neural_precision: Uniform FP8 E4M3 weights/activations in all nine neural stages, FP32 accumulation; linear head output FP16
protocol.reconstruction_precision: FP32 learned base/adaptive bank; native RGBA16F input/output for every head and precision
protocol.calibration: Same 24 training images, six held-out validation images, 128px deterministic crops; no benchmark calibration
protocol.metrics: Encoded RGB and MATLAB/BT.601 encoded Y; peak 1; RGB full border, Y full/shave2; Gaussian11 sigma1.5 SSIM
protocol.aggregation: Per-image means; natural-image sets reported separately; QRISP one correlated scene reported separately
protocol.inputs: Fresh aligned 2x2 area reduction from HR, uint8 round-half-up; no old LR images
protocol.scope: Fixed-backbone head ablation, not superiority over architectures separately optimized for each head
protocol.training_caveats: Adaptive basis uses its existing sparse gradient estimator; direct heads use dense autograd. Initial head/base paths differ.
